notes: State-driven score (CireMusic). Town = warm-up, breathers, prep and recovery; Combat = an advancing lane wave or an engaged challenge pack; Boss = a lane boss or engaged Pack Leader; Arena = PvP; the match end plays a victory or defeat stinger and then silence. Each state rotates through its tracks on every entry. holdSeconds keep Combat/Boss alive briefly after the last threat so short gaps do not flip the score.
